verdict.rationale: The vendor docs claim a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events. That would plausibly cover creating panes and sending commands on macOS. A hands-on runtime probe of Ghostty 1.3.1 found no remote-control or IPC interface, only config and +action CLI flags, and concluded an external script or agent cannot send commands to or read output from a running instance. Missing for 10: verified working control API, any documented way to read terminal output, cross-platform (non-macOS) control protocol, detailed protocol/API reference docs, independent corroboration that AppleScript control works for agents.
